facts.fact: The ICT minister told parliament that the 2023-24 audit found fewer than ten of the 123 online government services were actually used by citizens.
The ICT minister told parliament the KOREK app, launched on 30 January 2026 as a one-stop point for government services, had 462,310 registered and 413,409 active users.
